description:
Configure Memory keeps the preferences, projects, decisions and facts you choose in one profile you own, so the assistants you connect can use them and you don't have to repeat yourself.

Ask ChatGPT to remember something, save a short list of facts at once, or delete a memory it saved. Ask to see the list first if you want to review it, and each save is confirmed in the chat. Configure receives only the facts you ask ChatGPT to send.

For personalized help, ChatGPT searches the facts you saved. Review, edit or delete any memory, or disconnect ChatGPT, from your account at configure.dev.

Please don't save passwords, payment or health details, government IDs, or other people's personal information.

defaultPrompt: Remember that I use TypeScript for all new services.
What do you know about me from my Configure profile?
Save these to my Configure profile: I ship with pnpm, I'm rebuilding our onboarding flow, and I prefer short answers.
